name: Dit Dah
description: ITU Morse phrase player with 16th-quantized note-ons

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — Dit length (maps 30 ms up to four 16ths of the clock)
Alt — Pitch offset ±48 st around the base note
Third — Dah extra interval (deadzone; uses the Interval param). Main/Alt/Third mappings flip at playback when inverted

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Short — Mute / unmute (phrase keeps its place; Button LED off when muted, orange when live+normal, white when live+inverted)
Shift + short — Toggle texture: random MIDI velocity and swing on odd 16ths (Bottom LED white when on)
Long — Arm / retrigger on the next 16th (clock Reset also arms when idle)
Shift + long — Toggle invert: swap dit↔dah lengths and flip Main/Alt/Third fader mappings at playback

sections.heading: Params / LEDs
items: Needs clock. MIDI Start/Reset or the first 16th after ticks appear arms (analog Atom/Meteor/Cube has no Reset); then the phrase loops freely

Jack: CV Out Gate · CV Out Pitch · CV In Gate · CV In Dit length · CV In Pitch offset · CV In Dah interval. CV In Gate rising edge arms like long press. CV In dests add ±5 V bipolar on top of the saved fader at playback (not stored). V/Oct only for CV Out Pitch. MIDI note-ons always.
Invert swaps dit↔dah lengths and flips Main/Alt/Third fader mappings at playback. Texture adds random MIDI velocity and swing on odd 16ths.
Button LED off when muted; orange when live+normal; white when live+inverted. Bottom LED white when texture is on. Top LED high while a dit/dah sounds. Long press arms the next 16th.
Phrases 1–10 are packed ASCII (default Phrase 1 = SOS)

channels.jackDescription: CV Out Gate / CV Out Pitch (0–10 V V/Oct), CV In Gate (±5 V rising edge arms like long press), or CV In Dit length / Pitch offset / Dah interval (±5 V bipolar add at playback only). MIDI notes always fire.
channels.faderDescription: Duration of a dit in milliseconds, from 30 ms up to four 16th-notes of the incoming clock. Dah is 3× dit.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Bipolar transposition of the whole phrase around Base note, up to ±48 semitones.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Adds the Interval param onto dahs only (deadzone around centre). Dits stay on the Alt-offset pitch.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes MIDI and CV. Long press arms playback on the next 16th.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift+short toggles texture (random MIDI velocity + odd-16th swing). Shift+long inverts dit↔dah and flips speed/pitch at playback.
channels.ledTop: Orange high while a tone is sounding
channels.ledBottom: White when texture is on; off when texture is off
